title: 光学显微镜的使用
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/180_光学显微镜的使用.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/180_光学显微镜的使用/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台显微镜旁，手里拿着一张玻片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a light microscope on a lab bench, holding a glass slide by its edges, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十八课：光学显微镜的使用。

shots.scene: 阿杰单手拎着显微镜镜臂走过来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a microscope with one hand by the arm, swinging it while walking, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰单手拎着显微镜就走。

shots.scene: 他直接用高倍镜往下调，压碎了玻片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a high power objective lens pressing down onto a glass slide, a crack icon on the slide, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 上来就用高倍，一拧压碎了玻片。

shots.scene: 小研：双手搬，先低倍，侧面看着调
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows how to hold a microscope with one hand on the arm and one under the base.
shots.narration: 小研：双手搬，先低倍，侧面看着调。

shots.scene: 肉眼看不见的东西，借显微镜研究
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny dot invisible to an eye icon, then seen as cells through a microscope icon. No text.
shots.narration: 借显微镜研究看不见的小东西，叫显微术。

shots.scene: 显微镜把东西放大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small cell drawing growing much larger through a lens, hidden details appearing. No text.
shots.narration: 显微镜把物体放大，细节都能看清。

shots.scene: 光学显微镜用可见光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a beam of visible light passing up through a specimen into a lens system. No text.
shots.narration: 光学显微镜用可见光照亮标本再放大。

shots.scene: 生物学最常用：细胞、组织、小生物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a cell, a tissue section and a tiny organism, under a microscope. No text.
shots.narration: 生物学里常用它看细胞、组织和小生物。

shots.scene: 物镜：靠近标本，第一次放大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a microscope with the objective lenses highlighted near the slide, a first enlarged image icon. No text.
shots.narration: 靠近标本的是物镜，最先放大成像。

shots.scene: 四个倍数，100倍是油镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotating nosepiece with four objectives of increasing length, the longest one marked with an oil drop icon. No text.
shots.narration: 常见四个倍数，100倍的是油镜。

shots.scene: 倍数越高，镜头离玻片越近
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short low power objective far above a slide and a long high power objective very close to it, a small gap highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 倍数越高，物镜越长，离玻片越近。

shots.scene: 目镜：再放大一次，常是10倍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the eyepiece at the top highlighted, the image enlarged again, an eye looking in. No text.
shots.narration: 眼睛贴近的是目镜，多是10倍。

shots.scene: 光源亮度可调
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp in the base with a brightness dial turning from dim to bright. No text.
shots.narration: 光源亮度可调，调到看得舒服为止。

shots.scene: 钨丝灯、卤素灯、LED
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three lamp icons, a tungsten bulb, a halogen bulb and an LED chip. No text.
shots.narration: 光源有钨丝灯、卤素灯和LED。

shots.scene: 聚光器把光聚到标本上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a condenser under the stage focusing light evenly onto the slide. No text.
shots.narration: 台下的聚光器，把光聚到标本上。

shots.scene: 光阑控制光量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an iris diaphragm opening and closing, more light and less light reaching the slide. No text.
shots.narration: 光阑开合，控制照到标本的光量。

shots.scene: 载物台放玻片，前后左右移
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a slide held on the stage by a clip, arrows showing the stage moving forward, back, left and right. No text.
shots.narration: 载物台放玻片，移动标本到物镜下。

shots.scene: 大旋钮粗调，小旋钮细调
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a big coarse focus knob and a small fine focus knob on the side of a microscope. No text.
shots.narration: 大旋钮粗调，小旋钮细调。

shots.scene: 光穿过标本，发生折射
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: light rays bending as they pass through a specimen and a curved lens. No text.
shots.narration: 原理是折射和放大，结构由此显现。

shots.scene: 物镜成像，目镜再放大
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an objective forming an enlarged image, the eyepiece enlarging it again for the eye. No text.
shots.narration: 物镜成放大的像，目镜再放大给你看。

shots.scene: 总倍数＝物镜×目镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multiplication of forty by ten equals four hundred, with lens icons. No text.
shots.narration: 总倍数是两者相乘：40乘10是400倍。

shots.scene: 油镜100倍配10倍目镜是1000倍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a multiplication of one hundred by ten equals one thousand, with an oil objective icon. No text.
shots.narration: 油镜100乘目镜10，就是1000倍。

shots.scene: 【实拍】一手握镜臂，一手托镜座
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands lifting a microscope from a cabinet, one hand gripping the arm and the other supporting the base, held upright close to the body.
shots.narration: 一手握镜臂，一手托镜座，贴身端稳。

shots.scene: 放在平稳台面，离边缘远些
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a microscope placed on a stable bench a hand width from the edge, the power cord tidy, a microscope near the edge crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 放在平稳台面，离桌边远些，线理顺。

shots.scene: 不在台面上拖动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a microscope being dragged across a bench with a vibration icon, crossed out, and lifted and set down gently, checked. No text.
shots.narration: 移动时抬起轻放，不在台面上拖。

shots.scene: 卤素灯工作时很烫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glowing halogen lamp with heat waves and a hot surface warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 卤素灯工作时很烫，别用手碰。

shots.scene: 开关机前亮度调到最低
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a brightness dial turned to minimum, then the power switch pressed. No text.
shots.narration: 开关机前，先把亮度调到最低。

shots.scene: 换灯泡先断电，等凉了再换
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plug pulled out of a socket, a clock icon, then a cooled bulb being replaced. No text.
shots.narration: 换灯泡先拔电源，等它凉透再换。

shots.scene: 【实拍】转到低倍，玻片放进夹片器
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand rotating the lowest power objective into place and clipping a stained teaching slide onto the stage.
shots.narration: 先转到低倍物镜，玻片夹好。

shots.scene: 【实拍】从侧面看着，粗调升台靠近玻片
shots.prompt_en: Close-up from the side of a microscope stage being raised slowly with the coarse knob until the objective is just above the slide.
shots.narration: 从侧面看着，粗调让物镜靠近玻片。

shots.scene: 边看目镜，边让镜头离开玻片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye at the eyepiece, the stage moving away from the objective while the image becomes clear. No text.
shots.narration: 看着目镜，往远离玻片方向调到清晰。

shots.scene: 调好两眼间距和视度
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two eyepieces sliding closer and apart to match the eye distance, a small dial on one eyepiece. No text.
shots.narration: 双目镜先调好两眼间距和视度。

shots.scene: 【实拍】细调到最清楚，调光阑
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of fingers gently turning the small fine focus knob, then adjusting the diaphragm lever under the stage.
shots.narration: 细调到最清楚，再调光阑和亮度。

shots.scene: 玻片很薄，易碎易割手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thin glass slide and cover slip with a sharp edge icon and a cut finger icon. No text.
shots.narration: 玻片很薄，易碎也易割手。

shots.scene: 盖玻片朝上放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a slide placed on the stage with the cover slip facing up toward the objective, an upside down slide crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 玻片盖玻片朝上放，夹稳再看。

shots.scene: 先低倍找标本，再换高倍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a target found under low power, centered, then the nosepiece turned to a higher power objective. No text.
shots.narration: 先用低倍找到标本，移到中央再换高倍。

shots.scene: 高倍和油镜只用细调
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the high power objective with the fine knob checked and the coarse knob crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 高倍和油镜只用细调，别压碎玻片。

shots.scene: 碎玻片用镊子夹进锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tweezers picking up broken slide pieces and dropping them into a sharps container, bare hands crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 碎玻片用镊子夹，放进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 【实拍】油镜只滴一小滴镜油
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a single small drop of immersion oil placed on a slide, then the oil objective rotated into the drop.
shots.narration: 油镜只要一小滴镜油。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用完马上用擦镜纸擦净
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the oil objective wiped gently in one direction with lens paper right after use.
shots.narration: 用完马上用擦镜纸擦干净。

shots.scene: 沾油后别转回高倍干镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a nosepiece rotating the forty times objective back into an oil drop, crossed out, the lens kept clean. No text.
shots.narration: 加了油，别让40倍镜划过油滴。

shots.scene: 清洁溶剂少量、通风、远离火
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small dropper bottle of lens cleaning solvent with a flame icon crossed out and a ventilation icon checked. No text.
shots.narration: 清洁溶剂多易燃，少量用，要通风。

shots.scene: 废纸废液按化学废物收
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used lens paper and solvent waste going into a labeled chemical waste container, a regular trash bin crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 沾油沾溶剂的纸，按化学废物收集。

shots.scene: 只用教学菌株，按感染性材料对待
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a teaching strain tube with a check mark, an unknown sample crossed out, a biohazard caution icon. No text.
shots.narration: 涂片只用教学菌株，按有害材料对待。

shots.scene: 涂薄、晾干、固定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: step icons, a thin smear spread on a slide, air drying, then the slide passed quickly through a flame. No text.
shots.narration: 涂薄、自然晾干，再快速过火固定。

shots.scene: 固定用夹子夹，别烤太久
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a slide held with a slide clamp passed briefly over a flame, an overheated cracked slide crossed out, an alcohol bottle far away. No text.
shots.narration: 用玻片夹夹持过火，别烤裂，酒精远离。

shots.scene: 革兰染色：紫色和红色两类
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two groups of bacteria icons, one purple and one pink, after a staining sequence of four droppers. No text.
shots.narration: 革兰染色把细菌分成紫色和红色两类。

shots.scene: 染液戴手套，废液收集
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gloved hands holding a dropper over a staining tray, used stain collected into a waste bottle. No text.
shots.narration: 染液戴手套操作，废液统一收集。

shots.scene: 用过的玻片泡消毒液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used slides dropped into a jar of disinfectant, then into a sharps box. No text.
shots.narration: 用过的涂片泡消毒液，再进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 明场：亮背景，看染色样本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bright field view with a bright background and dark stained cells. No text.
shots.narration: 明场显微镜最常见，适合看染色样本。

shots.scene: 相差：透明活细胞不染色
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phase contrast view of transparent living cells appearing with clear outlines. No text.
shots.narration: 相差显微镜，透明活细胞不染也看清。

shots.scene: 荧光：看发光标记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dark background with brightly glowing labeled structures in green and red. No text.
shots.narration: 荧光显微镜看荧光染料或荧光蛋白。

shots.scene: 共聚焦：激光逐层扫描成三维
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser beam scanning a sample layer by layer, the layers stacking into a three dimensional image. No text.
shots.narration: 共聚焦用激光逐层扫描，拼成三维图。

shots.scene: 按样本和目的选类型
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a decision arrow from a stained sample to bright field, a living cell to phase contrast, a labeled sample to fluorescence. No text.
shots.narration: 按样本和目的，选合适的显微镜。

shots.scene: 激发光很强，有的含紫外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a strong excitation light beam with an ultraviolet icon and an eye icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 荧光激发光很强，有的含紫外线。

shots.scene: 滤片和遮光罩到位再观察
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a filter cube and a light shield in place on a fluorescence microscope, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 滤片和遮光罩到位，才能观察。

shots.scene: 共聚焦按激光安全规定使用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a confocal microscope with a laser warning sign and a closed enclosure, a training card. No text.
shots.narration: 共聚焦用激光，培训后按规定使用。

shots.scene: 科研与医学诊断
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a research cell image and a blood cell smear icon with a clinical cross icon. No text.
shots.narration: 科研看细胞组织，医学查血细胞和病变。

shots.scene: 材料学与质检
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a crystal structure image and a factory part being inspected under a microscope. No text.
shots.narration: 材料学看晶体结构，工厂查产品质量。

shots.scene: 分辨率有上限，约200纳米
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two tiny dots closer than a limit line merging into one blurry spot. No text.
shots.narration: 分辨率有上限，约200纳米以下看不清。

shots.scene: 景深有限，一次清楚一层
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a thick sample with only one thin layer in sharp focus, the rest blurred. No text.
shots.narration: 景深有限，一张图只清楚一层。

shots.scene: 染色固定会改变标本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a living cell changing shape after a fixing and staining step, a caution icon. No text.
shots.narration: 染色和固定，可能改变标本原样。

shots.scene: 有的标本对比度不足
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a faint, nearly invisible transparent sample on a bright background. No text.
shots.narration: 有些标本对比度太低，看不清楚。

shots.scene: 更小的结构用电子显微镜
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a light microscope reaching a limit, an arrow to an electron microscope icon revealing smaller structures. No text.
shots.narration: 更小的结构，要用电子显微镜。

shots.scene: 【实拍】取下玻片，转回低倍，降台
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a slide removed from the stage, the lowest power objective rotated back and the stage lowered.
shots.narration: 用完取下玻片，转回低倍，降下载物台。

shots.scene: 亮度调低再关灯，凉了再罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the brightness dial turned down, power off, a clock icon, then a dust cover placed over the microscope. No text.
shots.narration: 调低亮度再关机，凉了罩上防尘罩。

shots.scene: 镜头不用手摸、不用普通纸擦
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fingertip touching a lens crossed out, a tissue paper crossed out, lens paper checked. No text.
shots.narration: 镜头不用手摸，只用擦镜纸。

shots.scene: 登记使用，故障报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a usage logbook with a pen and a warning icon reporting a fault to a technician. No text.
shots.narration: 登记使用情况，有故障及时报告。

shots.scene: 双手搬，低倍起，侧面看
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a two hand carry icon, a low power objective icon and a side view eye icon, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 双手搬，低倍起，侧面看着调。

shots.scene: 一滴油，马上擦，玻片进锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oil drop, lens paper and a sharps box. No text.
shots.narration: 镜油一小滴，用完就擦，碎片进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 荧光激光别直视，涂片按有害材料
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an eye protection icon near a fluorescence light and a smear slide going into disinfectant. No text.
shots.narration: 强光别直视，涂片消毒后处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个小小的质粒环模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a small ring shaped model of a plasmid made of colored beads, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：质粒转化与合成生物学。
